title: a file whose first line break is CRLF gets the block written with CRLF line breaks
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). The file uses CRLF. The block, its markers and the breaks jitso adds are written with `\r\n`, so the file has no mixed line breaks. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.
